mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS style_id, s.code AS style_code, s.name AS style_name, s.alias_name, s.tag_price, p.id AS tech_pack_id, p.stage, p.version FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE p.status = 'EFFECTIVE' AND (p.stage = 'PROD' OR (p.stage = 'DEV' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tp_tech_pack x WHERE x.style_id = p.style_id AND x.stage = 'PROD' AND x.status = 'EFFECTIVE')))
AND (s.code ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR s.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR s.alias_name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR upper(s.code) IN #{code})
AND s.category_id IN #{id}
AND s.brand = #{q.brand} AND s.year = #{q.year} AND s.season = #{q.season} AND p.stage = #{q.stage} ORDER BY s.code DESC, s.id DESC
